title: Goblin Camp in a Gorge
name: scene_goblin_gorge
scene_summary: A narrow rock gorge running the length of the map with a war camp pitched along its floor: a fire burning in the middle, tents against the walls, timber platforms above, and a barricade across the far end.
render_details: Dry gravel and trodden dirt underfoot, sheer rock walls, a big open fire with a blackened cooking pot on it, crates and sacks, rough plank tables, filthy canvas tents, timber platforms on posts, rope ladders, drying hides strung on lines, scattered shields, spears and animal bones

rooms.label: Gorge Floor
rooms.description: The floor of the gorge: dry gravel and trodden dirt running the whole length between sheer rock walls, littered with shields, spears, empty bottles and animal bones. It is one continuous open floor with nothing built across it except what is described separately.

annotations.label: West Cliff
annotations.description: A band of raw rock running the whole length of the gorge on this side, seen from straight above as its broken irregular top, solid all the way with no way through it anywhere

annotations.label: East Cliff
annotations.description: A band of raw rock running the whole length of the gorge on this side, seen from straight above as its broken irregular top, solid all the way with no way through it anywhere

annotations.label: The Fire
annotations.description: A big open fire burning on the gravel, ringed with blackened stones, a heavy iron cooking pot standing on an iron tripod over it with thick steam rising from the pot

annotations.label: Crate Barricade
annotations.description: A short stack of crates and sacks heaped beside the fire to make a chest-high breastwork somebody could crouch behind

annotations.label: West Tents
annotations.description: Three low tents of filthy patched canvas pitched hard against the cliff, their guy ropes pegged into the gravel and their flaps hanging open

annotations.label: East Platform
annotations.description: A timber platform built out from the cliff on rough posts, standing well above the gorge floor, with a rickety ladder of lashed poles leading up to it and a clear view along the gorge from its deck

annotations.label: West Platform
annotations.description: A timber platform built out from the cliff on rough posts, standing well above the gorge floor, with a rickety ladder of lashed poles leading up to it and a clear view along the gorge from its deck

annotations.label: Drying Lines
annotations.description: Ropes strung across the gorge from one cliff to the other, hung with stretched hides and rags that block the view of what is beneath them

annotations.label: Log Barricade
annotations.description: A heavy barricade of lashed logs and planks thrown right across the gorge from wall to wall, blocking it completely except for a narrow gap at one side

annotations.label: Cave Mouth
annotations.description: A dark opening in the rock behind the barricade, its edges rough, nothing but blackness inside it
